u0: The agent is not yet carrying the matching door key. Since this level starts with the key in hand, this state mainly represents having lost the key before opening the door. Next objective: acquire the matching key, then open the locked door.
u1: The agent holds the matching door key, so the obligation to open the door is now active. Next objective: navigate to the locked door and toggle it open. Dropping the key while the door is still closed would fire key_lost and return to u0.
u2: The door is open and the key obligation is satisfied; the agent may still be carrying the key or may have dropped it, which is not a loss while the door is open. Next objective: enter the right room, free the hands if needed, and pick up the mission-named box.
u3: Terminal success: the mission's target box has been picked up and the episode ends. No further objective; the agent has completed unlocking the door and retrieving the designated box.
